channel.description: Latest articles from Tennessee Conservative – Bias and Credibility (tennesseeconservativenews.com)

item.title: Tennessee Illegal Aliens Sentenced To Decades In Federal Prison For West Tennessee Drug Trafficking & More...
item.description: Two Illegal Aliens From Mexico Are Now Serving Federal Sentences For Conspiring To Possess And Distribute Methamphetamine In Tennessee While Other Illegals In Davidson And Knox County Have Been Arrested On Charges Ranging From Aggravated Assault To Driving Under The Influence To Theft.

item.title: Tennessee Bill Will Create Regulations For Children Appearing In Paid Internet Content
item.description: A Bill Passed By Both Chambers Of The Tennessee General Assembly Will Set Rules For The Treatment Of Children Appearing In Paid Internet Content, Ensuring A Portion Of Profits Are Set Aside In Their Name And Allowing Them To Request The Permanent Removal Of Certain Content Featuring Them.

item.title: Bill Mandating Insurance Companies Cover Detransition Procedures To Become Tennessee Law
item.description: Legislation Mandating Insurance Companies Selling Policies Including Coverage For Medical Gender Transition Procedures Or Services Must Also Include Coverage For De-Transitioning Will Now Become Tennessee Law After The House Took Up The Bill For A Second Time And Agreed To Senate Amendments Adding More Enforcement Mechanisms And Clarifying Parameters.

item.title: Immigration Bills Requiring Citizenship Checks For Benefits, Removal Of Illegal Drivers, Increased Enforcement & More To Receive House Vote
item.description: Several Immigration-Related Bills Which Had Stalled Behind The Budget Were Quickly Approved By The House Finance, Ways, And Means Committee On Wednesday Evening And Will Now Receive A Full House Vote As The General Assembly Prepares To Finalize The State’s Budget For The Next Fiscal Year In The 2026 Legislative Session’s Final Stretch.

item.title: Truancy Bill Opposed By Tennessee Homeschool Families Passes On House Floor
item.description: After Passing In The Senate Last Month, A Truancy Bill That Has Been Opposed Both Within The Homeschool Community In Tennessee And At The National Level Has Passed On The House Floor.

item.title: Video Podcast: The “Mixed Bag” Of This Year’s Tennessee General Assembly | Tennessee Conservative
item.description: The “Mixed Bag” Of The 2026 Tennessee General Assembly: • Illegal Immigration • Expansion Of School Vouchers: Double-Funding Students with Strings Attached • Nashville: A Hard Place to get Good Things Done • Governor Lee: Setting the Bar Low… Steve Abramowicz from the Heartland Journal Podcast fills in on Yaffee LIVE and interviews The Tennessee Conservative’s founder, Brandon Lewis.

item.title: Gender Dysphoria - This Is NOT A Political Issue! (Op-ed By Kat Stansell)
item.description: Op-Ed: God Made Two Genders... The Birds And The Bees, And Most All Living Things Understand That. Until The Loony Left Decided To Make This Life Fundamental A Political Issue, There Was NO issue.

item.title: Tennessee's Marsha Blackburn Is Trumpcare's Most Steadfast Senate Supporter
item.description: Op-Ed: Tennessee’s Marsha Blackburn Is The Only U.S. Senator Standing Shoulder To Shoulder With President Trump In Advocating For Federal Funds To Be Directed Directly To The People So They Can Buy Affordable Insurance.

item.title: Tennessee Senate Allows Lawsuits Over Transgender Coercion
item.description: The Tennessee Senate Passed Legislation Monday Allowing Patients To Sue Their Doctor For “Coercing” Them Into Seeking Gender Reassignment Some 30 Years After Treatment.

item.title: Trump Says Memphis Safe Streets Task Force Has Reduced Crime By 43%
item.description: President Donald Trump Was In Memphis On Monday, Hailing The Memphis Safe Streets Task Force He Says Has Reduced Crime By 43% In The Past Six Months.

item.title: Tennessee GOP Senator Sounds Off On English-Only Driver’s License Bill
item.description: Tennessee Republicans’ White House-Backed Immigration Slate Is A Far Cry From Drawing Unanimous Support.

item.title: Clarksville Teacher Under Investigation For Showing Nude Photos To Student
item.description: Police Are Investigating An Incident In Which A Clarksville Teacher Allegedly Showed An “Inappropriate Picture” On His “Personal Device” To A Student By Accident.

item.title: Bill Creating Criminal Offense For School Employees Who Bully Students Passes Tennessee House Committee
item.description: In A Show Of Bipartisan Support, A Bill Which Will Make It A Crime For Employees Of Tennessee Schools And Local Education Agencies To Bully Or Harass Students Unanimously Passed The House Judiciary Committee On Monday, March 23.

item.title: Wrongful Death Lawsuit Eligibility Bill No Longer Expands Definition Of Tennessee’s Unborn Children
item.description: Legislation That Originally Sought To Expand The State’s Definition Of A Person For Whom A Wrongful Death Action May Be Brought To Include An Unborn Child Is Advancing In The Tennessee House.

item.title: Tennessee Bills Require Court Cooperation With Feds When Enforcing Immigration Law &amp; Expand Prohibitions Of Land Purchases By Foreign Adversaries
item.description: Two Pieces Of Legislation, One Reiterating That Judges Must Not Obstruct Lawful Immigration Enforcement Efforts And The Other Adding Additional Regulations On Foreign Entities Purchasing Land In The State, Have Progressed In The House And Senate, Moving Them One Step Closer To Becoming Law In Tennessee.
